subject: general
question: Who was NOT awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajeshwar Acharya**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajeshwar Acharya was awarded the Padma Shri in 2019**, but not the Padma Bhushan.
 
• Rajeshwar Acharya** is a Hindustani classical vocalist from Varanasi, India. **
 
• He** studied music from Banaras Hindu University** and practiced music under Pandit Balwantrai Bhatt.
 
• He **belongs to the Gwalior gharana of musi**c.
 
• He has been **associated with the arts and music department of the Banaras Hindu University and Deen Dayal Upadhyay Gorakhpur University.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Padma Bhushan awardees in 2019:
 
 
• J**ohn Chambers, a former CEO of CISCO Systems**
 
• **Sukhdev Singh Dhindsa, a public affairs awardee from Punjab**
 
• **Pravin Gordhan, a public affairs awardee from South Africa**
 
• **Mahashay Dharam Pal Gulati, a trade and industry awardee from Delhi**
 
• **Darshan Lal Jain, a social work awardee from Haryana**
 
• **Ashok Laxmanrao Kukade, an affordable healthcare awardee from Maharashtra**
 
• **Kariya Munda, a public affairs awardee from Jharkhand**
 
• **Budhaditya Mukherjee, an art-music-sitar awardee from West Bengal**
 
• **Mohanlal Viswanathan Nair, an art-acting-film awardee from Kerala**
 
• **S Nambi Narayan, a science awardee from Kerala**
